parts.name: Switch
parts.Basic_description: This is one of the four push switches on the wall switch panel, made of durable plastic.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as a button to control the electrical circuit, turning a connected device on or off.
parts.Movement_description: It moves inward when pressed and returns to its original position via a spring mechanism.

parts.name: Switch
parts.Basic_description: This is another push switch on the wall switch panel, made of plastic.
parts.Functional_description: It controls a separate electrical circuit or device, functioning independently from the other switches.
parts.Movement_description: It moves inward when pressed and returns to its resting position after release.

parts.name: Switch
parts.Basic_description: This is the third push switch on the wall switch panel, made of plastic.
parts.Functional_description: It acts as a control interface for another electrical function, such as lighting or fan control.
parts.Movement_description: It depresses when pressed and returns to its original position after release.

parts.name: Switch
parts.Basic_description: This is the fourth push switch on the wall switch panel, made of plastic.
parts.Functional_description: It provides an additional control point for an electrical circuit, similar to the other switches.
parts.Movement_description: It moves inward when pressed and returns outward when released.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the base body or faceplate of the wall switch panel, made of ABS plastic.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural support and houses the switches, protecting internal wiring and components.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and fixed to the wall or mounting box.
